18 Dublin hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Dublin hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Dublin hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 10, Hoteis.com at 1, Priceline at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Dublin rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 13 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 10, dealbase.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, Hoteis.com at 1, Priceline at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Dublin hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Arthaus Hotel to 14% at Marlin Hotel Dublin. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
